blocks.text: Qiyosiy daraja (comparative) shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 87–88-darslar): bir bo'g'inli sifatga `-er` qo'shiladi (cheap → cheap**er**), uzun sifat oldiga **more** qo'yiladi (**more** expensive), taqqoslanayotgan narsa **than** bilan keladi. Bu darsda e'tibor chegaradagi holatlarga qaratiladi: ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar, ravishlar, noto'g'ri shakllarning ma'no farqlari (**further** / **farther**, **elder** / **older**) va **less**. O'zbek tilida hammasi bitta `-roq` bilan hal bo'ladi — arzon**roq**, qimmat**roq**, uzoq**roq**. Inglizchada esa shakl so'zning tuzilishiga bog'liq, shuning uchun xatolar aynan shu yerda ko'p.
Ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar: eng qiyin guruh

Bir bo'g'inli va uzun sifatlar bilan muammo kam — qiyinchilik ikki bo'g'inlilarda. Ularni oxiriga qarab uch guruhga ajratish mumkin. (1) Undosh + `-y` bilan tugaganlar doim `-ier` oladi: bus**ier**, health**ier**, luck**ier**, nois**ier**. (2) `-ful`, `-less`, `-ing`, `-ed`, `-ous`, `-ive`, `-al` bilan tugaganlar faqat **more** oladi: **more** careful, **more** useless, **more** boring, **more** worried, **more** famous, **more** active, **more** formal. (3) `-ow`, `-le`, `-er`, `-et` bilan tugaganlar va ba'zi boshqalar ikkala yo'l bilan ham yasaladi: narrow**er** / **more** narrow, simpl**er** / **more** simple, clever**er** / **more** clever, quiet**er** / **more** quiet. Ikkilanib qolsangiz, **more** odatda xavfsizroq tanlov — faqat `-y` guruhida emas: «more busy» emas, **busier**.

items.text: Village life is **quieter**, but jobs there are **harder** to find.
items.translation: Qishloq hayoti **tinchroq**, lekin u yerda ish topish **qiyinroq**.

items.text: Be **more careful** when you cross this road — the cars go very fast.
items.translation: Bu yo'ldan o'tayotganda **ehtiyotkorroq** bo'ling — mashinalar juda tez yuradi.

items.text: Your room is much **tidier** than it was last week!

blocks.text: `-ed` bilan tugagan sifatlar bir bo'g'inli bo'lsa ham `-er` olmaydi: «tireder», «boreder» emas — **more tired**, **more bored**, **more scared**. **fun** ham shunday: «funner» emas, **more fun**; **real** → **more real**. `-ing` / `-ed` sifatlarning ma'no farqi — 98-dars.
Ravishlar: more slowly, lekin harder va earlier

`-ly` bilan yasalgan ravishlar **more** oladi, chunki ular kamida ikki bo'g'inli: **more slowly**, **more clearly**, **more seriously**. Sifat bilan bir xil ko'rinadigan ravishlar esa — **hard, fast, late, early, soon, long, high, near** — `-er` oladi: work **harder**, drive **faster**, arrive **later**, leave **sooner** (→ 101-dars). **early** dagi `-ly` qo'shimcha emas, so'zning o'z qismi, shuning uchun **earlier** — «more early» xato. So'zlashuvda **loud**, **slow**, **quick** ravish o'rnida ham keladi: Speak **louder**!, Can you walk **quicker**? Bu norasmiy uslub; rasmiy yozuvda **more loudly**, **more slowly**, **more quickly** afzal.

items.text: Can you explain it **more simply**? I'm not an engineer.
items.translation: Buni **soddaroq** tushuntira olasizmi? Men muhandis emasman.

items.text: The train left ten minutes **later** than the timetable said.
items.translation: Poyezd jadvalda ko'rsatilganidan o'n daqiqa **kechroq** jo'nadi.

items.text: If we leave **earlier**, we'll avoid the morning traffic.

blocks.text: **good** va **well** → **better**, **bad** va **badly** → **worse** (→ qizil kitob, 87-dars). Sog'liq haqida: I feel **better** — o'zimni yaxshiroq his qilyapman, tuzalyapman; My cough is getting **worse** — yo'talim kuchayyapti. **far** ning ikki shakli bor. Masofa haqida **further** ham, **farther** ham to'g'ri, British English'da **further** ko'proq ishlatiladi. Lekin «qo'shimcha, yana, keyingi» ma'nosida faqat **further** keladi: **further** information, **further** questions, until **further** notice — bu yerda farther ishlatilmaydi. Yana bir eslatma: **had better** (→ 35-dars) ko'rinishidan qiyosiy daraja, lekin ma'nosi boshqa — maslahat: You'd **better** go.

items.text: Thanks for the medicine — I feel a lot **better** today.
items.translation: Dori uchun rahmat — bugun o'zimni ancha **yaxshiroq** his qilyapman.

items.text: The traffic gets **worse** every time it rains.
items.translation: Har safar yomg'ir yog'sa, tirbandlik **battar** bo'ladi.

items.text: We'll send you **further** details by email next week.
items.translation: **Qo'shimcha** tafsilotlarni kelasi hafta elektron pochta orqali yuboramiz.

blocks.text: **older** — universal shakl: odamlar, binolar, narsalar haqida, **than** bilan ham, **be** dan keyin ham. **elder** esa faqat oila a'zolari haqida va faqat ot oldida keladi: my **elder** brother (akam), her **elder** sister (opasi), their **elder** son (katta o'g'li). Ikki kishidan kattasi haqida **the elder** ham deyiladi: Madina is **the elder** of the two. «elder than» va «He is elder» deyilmaydi — faqat **older than**, He's **older**. O'zbekchada «aka», «opa» so'zlarining o'zi yoshni bildiradi, shuning uchun my elder brother o'zbeklarga tabiiy tuyuladi. Bu to'g'ri, lekin zamonaviy so'zlashuvda **my older brother** yoki **my big brother** ham juda ko'p eshitiladi. Orttirma darajasi — **eldest** / **oldest** (→ 108-dars).

rows: oila a'zosi, ot oldida — ikkalasi ham
She's two years elder than me.

blocks.text: **less** «kamroq», «unchalik ... emas» degan ma'no beradi va **more** o'rnida turadi: **less** expensive (arzonroq), **less** often (kamroq), **less** stressful. Qisqa sifatlar bilan less kam ishlatiladi: «less tall», «less cheap» o'rniga qarama-qarshi sifat (**shorter**, **more expensive**) yoki **not as ... as** tabiiyroq (→ 107-dars). Ot bilan: **less** + sanalmaydigan ot (less time, less traffic, less money), **fewer** + sanaladigan ko'plik ot (fewer cars, fewer mistakes, fewer people). So'zlashuvda «less people» ham eshitiladi, lekin rasmiy yozuvda va imtihonda bu xato hisoblanadi.

items.text: The village is **less crowded** in winter, when the tourists have gone.
items.translation: Qishda, sayyohlar ketgach, qishloq **unchalik gavjum bo'lmaydi**.

items.text: Nowadays I drink **less** coffee and more water.
items.translation: Hozir **kamroq** qahva va ko'proq suv ichaman.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «more cheaper», «more easier» → **cheaper**, **easier** (`-er` va more birga kelmaydi); «more busy», «more early» → **busier**, **earlier**; «tireder», «funner» → **more tired**, **more fun**; «farer», «more far» → **further** / **farther**; «farther information» → **further information**; «She is elder than me» → She's **older than** me; «less people», «less mistakes» → **fewer** people, **fewer** mistakes; «more good», «badder» → **better**, **worse**.

Tez tekshirish: so'zni bo'g'inlarga bo'ling. Bitta bo'g'in → `-er`; ikki bo'g'in va `-y` → `-ier`; ikki bo'g'in va `-ful` / `-ing` / `-ed` / `-ous` → **more**; uch va undan ko'p → **more**. Ravishda: `-ly` bo'lsa → **more**, bo'lmasa (hard, fast, early) → `-er`. Ot oldida: sanalsa — **fewer**, sanalmasa — **less**.

Bog'lanish: farqni kuchaytirish (much better, a bit cheaper, any better, the more ... the better) — 106-dars; as ... as, than me / than I am — 107-dars; orttirma daraja — 108-dars; hard / hardly, fast, late — 101-dars.

examples.title: Short adjectives: **cheaper**, **wetter**, **busier**
examples.description: Bir bo'g'inli va `-y` bilan tugagan sifatlar: `-er`, `-ier`, undosh ikkilanishi — real vaziyatlarda.

sentences.text: Train tickets are **cheaper** if you book them a month in advance.
sentences.translation: Poyezd chiptalarini bir oy oldin band qilsangiz, ular **arzonroq** bo'ladi.

sentences.text: This spring has been **wetter** than usual, so the roads are in a terrible state.
sentences.translation: Bu bahor odatdagidan **yomg'irliroq** keldi, shuning uchun yo'llar juda yomon ahvolda.

sentences.text: Our new office is **bigger**, but the kitchen is **smaller** than before.
sentences.translation: Yangi ofisimiz **kattaroq**, lekin oshxonasi avvalgidan **kichikroq**.

sentences.text: Saturdays are always **busier** at the bazaar, so we go on Tuesdays.
sentences.translation: Bozor shanba kunlari doim **gavjumroq** bo'ladi, shuning uchun biz seshanba kuni boramiz.

sentences.text: Could you turn the heating up? It's getting **colder** in here.
sentences.translation: Isitishni kuchaytira olasizmi? Bu yer **sovuqroq** bo'lib qolyapti.

sentences.text: Dilnoza looks **healthier** since she started cycling to work.
sentences.translation: Ishga velosipedda qatnay boshlaganidan beri Dilnoza **sog'lomroq** ko'rinyapti.

sentences.text: Is the bus **faster** than the metro at this time of day?
sentences.translation: Kunning shu vaqtida avtobus metrodan **tezroq**mi?

sentences.text: My laptop is getting **slower** every month, so I need a **newer** one.
sentences.translation: Noutbukim oydan oyga **sekinlashib** boryapti, menga **yangiroq** kompyuter kerak.

sentences.text: After the storm the air in Fergana felt **fresher** and **cleaner**.
sentences.translation: Bo'rondan keyin Farg'onada havo **musafforoq** va **tozaroq** bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: The **thinner** model is **lighter**, but its battery runs out **sooner**.
sentences.translation: **Yupqaroq** model **yengilroq**, lekin uning batareyasi **tezroq** tugaydi.

examples.title: Two-syllable adjectives: **quieter** or **more careful**?
examples.description: Ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar: `-y` → `-ier`; `-ful`, `-ing`, `-ed`, `-ous` → faqat **more**; quiet, narrow, simple — ikkala shakl ham.

sentences.text: You need to be **more careful** with your passwords after that hacking attack.
sentences.translation: O'sha xakerlik hujumidan keyin parollaringizga **ehtiyotkorroq** bo'lishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: The second lecture was **more boring** than the first, and half the students left.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi ma'ruza birinchisidan **zerikarliroq** edi, talabalarning yarmi chiqib ketdi.

sentences.text: Strangely, I felt **more tired** after the holiday than before it.
sentences.translation: G'alati, ta'tildan keyin o'zimni avvalgidan **ko'proq charchagan** his qildim.

sentences.text: Our new neighbourhood is **quieter**, but the flats there are smaller.
sentences.translation: Yangi mahallamiz **tinchroq**, lekin u yerdagi kvartiralar kichikroq.

sentences.text: The streets in the old part of Bukhara are **narrower** than in the new town.
sentences.translation: Buxoroning eski qismidagi ko'chalar yangi shahardagidan **torroq**.

sentences.text: Could you make the instructions **simpler**? The users are confused.
sentences.translation: Ko'rsatmalarni **soddaroq** qila olasizmi? Foydalanuvchilar chalkashib qolyapti.

sentences.text: Sarah seems much **happier** since she changed jobs.
sentences.translation: Ish joyini almashtirganidan beri Sara ancha **baxtliroq** ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Smaller towns often feel **friendlier** and **more relaxed** than capitals.
sentences.translation: Kichik shaharlar ko'pincha poytaxtlarga qaraganda **samimiyroq** va **osoyishtaroq** tuyuladi.

sentences.text: Which is **more useful** at a job interview — a degree or experience?
sentences.translation: Ish suhbatida qaysi biri **foydaliroq** — diplommi yoki tajriba?

sentences.text: For Jasur, online classes were **more stressful** but also **more flexible** than lectures at university.
sentences.translation: Jasur uchun onlayn darslar universitetdagi ma'ruzalardan **ko'proq stress berardi**, lekin **qulayroq** ham edi.

examples.title: Long adjectives: **more reliable**, **more convenient**
examples.description: Uch va undan ortiq bo'g'inli sifatlar faqat **more** bilan — texnologiya, ish va sog'liq mavzularida.

sentences.text: Electric cars are becoming **more popular** in Tashkent every year.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda elektromobillar yildan yilga **mashhurroq** bo'lib boryapti.

sentences.text: Paying by card is **more convenient** than carrying cash around.
sentences.translation: Karta bilan to'lash naqd pul olib yurishdan **qulayroq**.

sentences.text: We need a **more reliable** supplier, because this one is always late.
sentences.translation: Bizga **ishonchliroq** yetkazib beruvchi kerak, chunki bunisi doim kechikadi.

sentences.text: My new job is **more demanding**, but it's also **more interesting**.
sentences.translation: Yangi ishim **og'irroq**, lekin **qiziqarliroq** ham.

sentences.text: Is it **more expensive** to fly to London from Tashkent or from Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Londonga Toshkentdan uchish **qimmatroq**mi yoki Samarqanddanmi?

sentences.text: Doctors say that walking is **more effective** than many people think.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, piyoda yurish ko'pchilik o'ylagandan **samaraliroq**.

sentences.text: The exam questions this year were **more difficult**, so the pass rate fell.
sentences.translation: Bu yilgi imtihon savollari **qiyinroq** edi, shuning uchun o'tganlar ulushi pasaydi.

sentences.text: Nilufar became **more confident** after she gave her first presentation.
sentences.translation: Birinchi taqdimotini qilgandan keyin Nilufar **o'ziga ishonchliroq** bo'lib qoldi.

sentences.text: Surprisingly, the night train to Khiva was **more comfortable** than we had expected.
sentences.translation: Ajabki, Xivaga ketadigan tungi poyezd biz kutganimizdan **qulayroq** ekan.

sentences.text: Modern phones are **more powerful** than the computers we used twenty years ago.
sentences.translation: Zamonaviy telefonlar biz yigirma yil oldin ishlatgan kompyuterlardan **kuchliroq**.

examples.title: Adverbs: **more carefully**, **harder**, **earlier**
examples.description: `-ly` bilan yasalgan ravishlar **more** oladi; hard, fast, late, early, soon kabi ravishlar `-er` oladi.

sentences.text: Could you speak **more slowly**, please? My English isn't very good.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, **sekinroq** gapira olasizmi? Ingliz tilim unchalik yaxshi emas.

sentences.text: If you want a promotion, you'll have to work **harder** this year.
sentences.translation: Lavozimingiz oshishini istasangiz, bu yil **astoydilroq** ishlashingizga to'g'ri keladi.

sentences.text: Madina gets up **earlier** than the rest of the family to study.
sentences.translation: Madina dars qilish uchun oilaning qolgan a'zolaridan **ertaroq** turadi.

sentences.text: Drivers should behave **more responsibly** near schools and hospitals.
sentences.translation: Haydovchilar maktab va shifoxonalar yaqinida o'zini **mas'uliyatliroq** tutishi kerak.

sentences.text: The meeting finished **later** than planned, so I missed my train.
sentences.translation: Majlis rejalashtirilganidan **kechroq** tugadi, shuning uchun poyezdga ulgurmadim.

sentences.text: Read the contract **more carefully** before you sign anything.
sentences.translation: Biror narsaga imzo chekishdan oldin shartnomani **sinchkovroq** o'qib chiqing.

sentences.text: Our new manager explains things **more clearly** than the old one did.
sentences.translation: Yangi rahbarimiz narsalarni avvalgisidan **aniqroq** tushuntiradi.

sentences.text: We should have left **sooner** — now the traffic is terrible.
sentences.translation: **Ertaroq** chiqishimiz kerak edi — endi tirbandlik dahshat.

sentences.text: Kate types **faster** on a laptop than on her phone.
sentences.translation: Keyt noutbukda telefondagidan **tezroq** yozadi.

sentences.text: Since the accident, Bekzod drives **more slowly** and stops **more often**.
sentences.translation: Avariyadan keyin Bekzod mashinani **sekinroq** haydaydi va **ko'proq** to'xtaydi.

examples.title: Irregular: **better**, **worse**, **further**
examples.description: good / well → better, bad / badly → worse, far → further / farther. **further** ning «qo'shimcha, keyingi» ma'nosi.

sentences.text: The weather in Edinburgh was **worse** than the forecast said.
sentences.translation: Edinburgda ob-havo prognozda aytilganidan **yomonroq** edi.

sentences.text: Aziz speaks English **better** now because he watches films without subtitles.
sentences.translation: Aziz endi ingliz tilida **yaxshiroq** gapiradi, chunki filmlarni subtitrsiz ko'radi.

sentences.text: My headache got **worse** in the afternoon, so I went home early.
sentences.translation: Tushdan keyin boshim battar **og'rib ketdi**, shuning uchun uyga erta ketdim.

sentences.text: Is the hospital much **further**, or can we walk from here?
sentences.translation: Kasalxona hali ancha **uzoq**mi yoki bu yerdan piyoda borsak bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: For **further** information, please contact the university office.
sentences.translation: **Qo'shimcha** ma'lumot uchun universitet idorasiga murojaat qiling.

sentences.text: The museum is closed until **further** notice because of repairs.
sentences.translation: Muzey ta'mir sababli **keyingi** xabargacha yopiq.

sentences.text: Do you have any **further** questions before we finish the meeting?
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishni tugatishdan oldin **yana** savollaringiz bormi?

sentences.text: Sarah's flat is **farther** from the station than mine, so she usually takes a taxi.
sentences.translation: Saraning kvartirasi bekatdan menikiga qaraganda **uzoqroq**, shuning uchun u odatda taksida yuradi.

sentences.text: Which is **better** for your back — running or swimming?
sentences.translation: Belingiz uchun qaysi biri **yaxshiroq** — yugurishmi yoki suzishmi?

sentences.text: Jasur did **worse** in the second test because he hadn't slept the night before.
sentences.translation: Jasur ikkinchi testni **yomonroq** topshirdi, chunki oldingi kechasi uxlamagan edi.

examples.title: **elder** or **older**?
examples.description: **elder** — faqat oila a'zolari haqida va ot oldida (my elder sister). **than** bilan, **be** dan keyin va narsalar haqida — faqat **older**.

sentences.text: My **elder** sister works as a nurse in a hospital in Manchester.
sentences.translation: **Opam** Manchesterdagi shifoxonada hamshira bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod is two years **older** than his wife.
sentences.translation: Bekzod xotinidan ikki yosh **katta**.

sentences.text: Their **elder** son is studying law at Oxford, and the younger one is still at school.
sentences.translation: Ularning **katta** o'g'li Oksfordda huquqshunoslikni o'qiyapti, kichigi esa hali maktabda.

sentences.text: Is your brother **older** or younger than you?
sentences.translation: Aka-ukangiz sizdan **katta**mi yoki kichikmi?

sentences.text: The **older** buildings in the centre look more beautiful than the new ones.
sentences.translation: Markazdagi **eskiroq** binolar yangilaridan chiroyliroq ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Nilufar always asks her **elder** brother for advice about money.
sentences.translation: Nilufar pul masalasida doim **akasidan** maslahat so'raydi.

sentences.text: Grandpa looks **older** since his illness, but he's still very active.
sentences.translation: Kasallikdan keyin bobom **qariroq** ko'rinadi, lekin hali ham juda harakatchan.

sentences.text: Of the two sisters, Madina is the **elder**, but Dilnoza is taller.
sentences.translation: Ikki opa-singildan Madina **kattasi**, lekin Dilnoza bo'yliroq.

sentences.text: In Uzbek families, **older** relatives are treated with great respect.
sentences.translation: O'zbek oilalarida **yoshi kattaroq** qarindoshlarga katta hurmat ko'rsatiladi.

sentences.text: Emma is the **older** twin, but only by ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Emma egizaklarning **kattasi**, lekin atigi o'n daqiqaga.

examples.title: **less** and **fewer**: less stressful, fewer mistakes
examples.description: **less** + sifat yoki ravish («kamroq», «unchalik ... emas»), **less** + sanalmaydigan ot, **fewer** + sanaladigan ko'plik ot.

sentences.text: Working from home is **less stressful** than commuting for two hours a day.
sentences.translation: Uydan ishlash har kuni ikki soat yo'lda yurishga qaraganda **kamroq charchatadi**.

sentences.text: I eat **less** sugar now, and I feel much better.
sentences.translation: Hozir **kamroq** shakar yeyman va o'zimni ancha yaxshi his qilyapman.

sentences.text: There were **fewer** passengers on the plane than usual, so we had more space.
sentences.translation: Samolyotda odatdagidan **kamroq** yo'lovchi bor edi, shuning uchun joyimiz kengroq edi.

sentences.text: The second edition of the book is **less expensive**, but it has **fewer** pictures.
sentences.translation: Kitobning ikkinchi nashri **arzonroq**, lekin unda rasmlar **kamroq**.

sentences.text: We've seen our cousins in Fergana **less often** since we moved to Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga ko'chib kelganimizdan beri Farg'onadagi amakivachchalarimizni **kamroq** ko'ryapmiz.

sentences.text: Emma made **fewer** mistakes in her second essay because she checked it twice.
sentences.translation: Emma ikkinchi inshosida **kamroq** xato qildi, chunki uni ikki marta tekshirdi.

sentences.text: Is the new version of the app **less complicated** than the old one?
sentences.translation: Ilovaning yangi versiyasi eskisidan **soddaroq**mi?

sentences.text: **Fewer** young people smoke today than twenty years ago.
sentences.translation: Bugun yigirma yil oldingiga qaraganda **kamroq** yosh chekadi.

sentences.text: Try to spend **less** time on your phone before you go to bed.
sentences.translation: Uxlashdan oldin telefonda **kamroq** vaqt o'tkazishga harakat qiling.

sentences.text: Since the new metro line opened, the city has **fewer** traffic jams and **less** pollution.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi ochilgandan beri shaharda tirbandlik ham, havo ifloslanishi ham **kamroq**.

examples.title: Dialogue: choosing between two flats
examples.description: Ikki do'st ikkita kvartirani taqqoslaydi: `-er`, **more**, **less**, **further**, **worse** — hammasi bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — So, which flat did you like **better**, the one in Chilanzar or in Yunusabad?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, qaysi kvartira sizga **ko'proq** yoqdi, Chilonzordagimi yoki Yunusoboddagimi?

sentences.text: — The Yunusabad one is **bigger** and **brighter**, but it's **further** from my office.
sentences.translation: — Yunusoboddagisi **kattaroq** va **yorug'roq**, lekin ofisimdan **uzoqroq**.

sentences.text: — Is the rent **higher** there, or is it about the same?
sentences.translation: — U yerda ijara haqi **balandroq**mi yoki taxminan bir xilmi?

sentences.text: — Actually, it's **less expensive**, because the building is **older**.
sentences.translation: — Aslida u **arzonroq**, chunki bino **eskiroq**.

sentences.text: — Older buildings often have **thicker** walls, so they're **quieter**.
sentences.translation: — Eski binolarning devorlari ko'pincha **qalinroq** bo'ladi, shuning uchun ularda **tinchroq**.

sentences.text: — True, but the heating might be **worse** in winter.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri, lekin qishda isitish **yomonroq** bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: — The owner told me they'd installed a **more modern** boiler last year.
sentences.translation: — Egasi o'tgan yili **zamonaviyroq** qozon o'rnatishganini aytdi.

sentences.text: — Then the journey is the only problem. How much **longer** would it take you?
sentences.translation: — Unda faqat yo'l muammo. Sizga yo'lga qancha **ko'proq** vaqt ketadi?

sentences.text: — About twenty minutes, but the metro is **faster** and **more reliable** than the bus.
sentences.translation: — Taxminan yigirma daqiqa, lekin metro avtobusdan **tezroq** va **ishonchliroq**.

sentences.text: — Then take it! A **quieter** flat is **more important** than a **shorter** journey.
sentences.translation: — Unda oling! **Tinchroq** kvartira **qisqaroq** yo'ldan **muhimroq**.
